book_title: The Second Epistle of John the Apostle.

verses.text: <sc>THE</sc> Senior to the lady Elect and her children, vvhom I loue in truth, and not I onely, but also al that haue knovven the truth,
for the truth vvhich abideth in vs, and shal be vvith vs for euer.
Grace be vvith you, mercie, peace from God the Father, and from Christ <sc>IESVS</sc> the sonne of the Father in truth, and charitie.
I vvas exceding glad, because I haue found of thy children vvalking in truth, as vve haue receiued commaundement of the Father.
And novv I beseeche thee Lady, not as vvriting a nevv commaundement to thee, but that vvhich vve haue had from the beginning, <cr>[1]</cr> that vve loue one an other.
And this is charitie, that vve vvalke according to his commaundements. For this is the commaundement, that as you haue heard from the beginning, you vvalke in the same:
because many seducers are gone out into the vvorld, vvhich do not confesse <sc>IESVS</sc> Christ to haue come into flesh: this is a seducer and an antichrist.
Looke to your selues, that you lose not the thinges vvhich you haue vvrought: but that you may receiue a ful <na>[1]</na> revvard.

notes.text: Reward for keeping fast the Catholic faith.

verses.text: Euery one that <na>[1]</na> c reuolteth, and persisteth not in in the doctrine of Christ: hath not God. He that persisteth in the doctrine: the same hath both the Father, and the Sonne.

notes.text: To goe backe or reuolt from the receiued truth and doctrine Apostolical, is damnable.

verses.text: If [1] any man come to you, and bring not this doctrine: receiue him not into the house, nor say, God saue you, vnto him.
For he that saith vnto him, God saue you, communicateth vvith his vvicked vvorkes.
Hauing moe thinges to vvrite vnto you: I vvould not by paper and inke: for I hope that I shal be vvith you, and speake mouth to mouth: that your ioy may be ful.
The children of thy sister electe salute thee.

chapters.summary: He commendeth the lady and her sonnes for continuing in the old faith, bidding them so to doe hereafter also, lest they lose the revvard of their vvorkes in the day of iudgement: and to loue the true beleeuers, but vvith Heretikes to haue no societie: expressing also the points then in controuersie.
